sections.advice: This Scenic stretch near Kings Point → High point in Woodmere stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Rumson → Bath Beach is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 28 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-grosii-tiblesului-izvorul-surii-w.story: From Groșii Țibleșului it runs 91 km to Groșii Țibleșului; allow about 1 h 34 of riding. The stops in between: Strimbu Băiuț, Wooden Churches of Maramureş and back through Strimbu Băiuț. The line favours views over speed.
